name: payment-plan-picker
title: Payment plan picker
description: Pay in full or in parts: plans as choice cards with the amount per payment, the total, and the schedule of the chosen plan beneath.
docs: total is the price of the order in minor units. plans are { id, payments, amount (one regular payment), total (everything the plan costs), apr?, firstPaymentToday?, label? }: a plan with one payment is 'Pay in full', what a plan costs above total is its interest, and a plan without any says 'No interest'. When total is not payments times amount the first payment takes the difference, so the schedule always adds up to the plan's total to the cent, and a line under the schedule says so in words ('The first payment is €205.45 because the cents do not divide evenly. The others are €205.41.'). The chosen plan's schedule is a real list beneath the cards: today, then one date a month in words (a plan that starts next month, firstPaymentToday false, has no 'today'; 31 January plus a month is 28 February), with the total, the interest and the representative APR under it. value, defaultValue and onValueChange control the choice, and onContinue(plan) adds a button. disclosure is whatever the law makes you say about this credit (a representative example, who provides it, what a missed payment means): it is always on the page under the plans, never behind a tooltip. now and timeZone give the calendar day the dates start from: pass now from the server so the first render already shows dates; without it the schedule says 'In 1 month' until the browser's clock is known and then turns those into dates. currency and locale write the amounts, a polite status says which plan was chosen, headingAs is 'h3' inside a section that has its own h2, and labels holds the fixed words.
